channel.title: Jasman Tan — Build notes
channel.description: Build notes by Jasman Tan: engineering stories from jhub, a self-hosted family media hub built with AI coding agents. Debugging, testing, operations and working with agents.

item.title: Building with AI agents without losing control
item.description: The rules I use so AI coding agents can move fast on a family app without me trusting their reports: branch-only agents, owner-run merges, a separate test instance, and verifying claims instead of believing them.

item.title: Why my speaker played nothing
item.description: Casting a video's sound to a smart speaker showed "playing" and made no noise. Reproducing it in real Chrome, a range request answered wrongly, a flaky test that was a real race, and a sandbox bug the tests could not see.

item.title: The playlist sync that ran for six days
item.description: A media server API quirk made my sync delete and recreate playlists on every pass. Nothing alerted me for six days. How I found it, fixed it in two passes, and added a 03:00 health check.
